jobs.name: k1
lines: Square root of seven thousand five hundred and sixty-nine.
Last digit nine, so the answer ends in three or seven.
Cover the last two digits. Seventy-five.
Eight squared is sixty-four. Nine squared is eighty-one, too big. So it starts with eight.
Eighty-three or eighty-seven? Eight times nine is seventy-two.
Seventy-five is bigger, so pick the bigger one. Eighty-seven!
Your turn: square root of three thousand nine hundred and sixty-nine.

jobs.name: k2
lines: Add them. Fifteen. Too big for the middle!
Write the five, and carry the one onto the seven.

jobs.name: k3
lines: Here's the trick. Twenty-five is a hundred divided by four.
So divide thirty-six by four. Nine.
Then times a hundred. Nine hundred!

jobs.name: k4
lines: Three hundred and forty, divided by five.
Here's the trick. Double it, then divide by ten.
Double three hundred and forty is six hundred and eighty.
Your turn: four hundred and twenty divided by five.
